//: Off, and what keeps it off is narrower than it used to be.
A scenario is converted once per test run now, so the wipe-and-regenerate that classes
used to do to each other is gone. What is left is three tests that walk an output tree
and judge every file in it - the golden comparison, the file-ending gate and the
generated-marker gate. Those convert fresh, because the conformance harness builds Go,
Rust, Java, Kotlin, Dart and Python inside the directory each was generated into, and a
walker would take a compiler's working files for output. Fresh means clearing, and in
parallel that clears a tree another class is compiling in.
Measured, so the trade is not a guess: serial is 13m21s and every test passes; parallel
is 3m25s and 52 fail, all of them that race. What would earn the four minutes back is
moving the in-place builds out of the generated trees - CsToolchain already builds in
`_cscheck` and only reads what was generated. doc/roadmap.md, 아직 안 함.
